propositions: set_project accepts any string key without validation, allowing syntactically-invalid keys to persist to projects.json
Adding syntactic validation via fetcher._validate_project_key at write time in set_project and remove_project prevents invalid keys from being persisted or published
Invalid keys (empty string, leading digit, non-alphanumeric characters, trailing whitespace) must be rejected with clear error and no file mutation before atomic_write
The ValueError from key validation must be mapped to RebarError(returncode=2) at the _lib_ops seam so CLI and MCP consumers surface a clean non-zero error with no traceback
The validation reuses existing _validate_project_key regex without duplication and adds no network/Jira calls or seam changes
